Title: General availability: Recover Generation 2 virtual machines to Azure

Body.Content: You can now protect and recover Generation 2 virtual machines to Azure by using Azure Site Recovery (ASR). This feature is now available in all Azure regions that are supported by ASR (East US, West US, North Europe, West Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, Japan East, Japan West, Australia East, and Australia Southeast). For more details, check out Disaster Recovery to Azure enhanced, and we’re listening!
